correctness.rationale: The axial radius law has density 3s²; independent disk-point moments reduce every claimed coefficient to exact polynomial integration. The three displayed rational moment polynomials were checked coefficient by coefficient with exact Fraction integration in verify.py. Equality of normalized fourth moments factors as (r-u)(69ru+158r+158u-1888); the nontrivial partner is u=2(944-79r)/(69r+158). Exact expansion yields F3(r)-F3(u)=3(69r-236)(224479r²-1356188r+3036792)/(30581492(r+8)³). The quadratic has positive leading coefficient and negative discriminant -887538234128, giving strict separation away from r=u; positive shape parameters and excluded boundaries were evaluated explicitly. A fixed-seed independently constructed cone sampler corroborated, but does not substitute for, these infinite proofs.

value.rationale: Random Euclidean interpoint-distance histograms are natural orientation-free shape descriptors. Exactly when two even moments fail is a mathematically motivated inverse problem, and this theorem gives the complete positive-cone phase diagram, a precise twofold ambiguity interval, explicit alternative aspect ratio, exact sixth-moment separating identity, and globally minimal cutoff among consecutive even moments. The value lies in the new finite-measurement classification, not mere calculation of a known inertia coefficient. No broad downstream application or noisy-data guarantee is asserted.
